verify.label: columns of tags
verify.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default, is_identity FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'tags' ORDER BY ordinal_position

verify.label: columns of product_tags
verify.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default IS NOT NULL AS has_default, is_identity FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'product_tags' ORDER BY ordinal_position

verify.label: two tags with the same name are rejected
an unknown product is rejected
verify.sql: INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES ('t'); INSERT INTO product_tags (product_id, tag_id) SELECT 999999, tag_id FROM tags

verify.label: a valid link is accepted
verify.sql: INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES ('t'); INSERT INTO product_tags (product_id, tag_id) SELECT 1, tag_id FROM tags

verify.label: the same tag on the same product twice is rejected
verify.sql: INSERT INTO tags (name) VALUES ('t'); INSERT INTO product_tags (product_id, tag_id) SELECT 1, tag_id FROM tags; INSERT INTO product_tags (product_id, tag_id) SELECT 1, tag_id FROM tags
